rows.summary: ElastiCache supports the Internet Protocol versions 4 and 6 (IPv4 and IPv6), allowing you to configure your cluster to accept only IPv4 connections, only IPv6 connections or both IPv4 and IPv6 connections (dual-stack). IPv6 is supported for workloads using Redis OSS engine version 6.2 onward on all instances built on the Nitro system. There are no additional charges for accessing ElastiCache over IPv6. For more information, see Choosing a network type.
